name: Study Flow
summary: A shared study setup, inline answer feedback, and filtered progress with direct review actions.

features.title: Faster question selection
features.text: Sessions choose matching questions before loading their full text and explanations.

features.title: One study setup
features.text: Choose Practice, Flashcards, or Exam from Study. Resume an unfinished session from the same screen.

features.title: Feedback beside your answer
features.text: Read the explanation, alternate choices, and reference directly below a checked answer. Exam feedback follows its existing release rules.

features.title: Progress with matching filters
features.text: First-answer accuracy, questions covered, and questions needing review follow the same filters. Start a review from a topic.

features.title: Separate question tools
features.text: Bookmark a question, make a private note, or report a problem with separate controls. Recall-rating help is beside the grades.

features.title: Remembered setup
features.text: Start with 5, 10, or 20 questions, or customize the pool, difficulty, and topics. Your setup is remembered after a successful start.
